zh-CN:
用法：
  remote-agent session create [选项] [-- 底层CLI参数]

在后台启动托管会话，不占用当前终端，并向标准输出打印会话 ID。
先运行 remote-agent models AGENT 可查看可选模型 ID、显示名、支持的推理强度及本机默认配置。

选项：
  --agent {agents}          要启动的 CLI（默认：{defaultAgent}）
  --cwd DIR                 会话工作目录（默认：当前目录）
  --model MODEL             模型 ID 或客户端显示名（如 gemini-pro-orchestrator 或 "Orchestrator (Carbon)"；省略则跟随本机/CLI 默认值）
  --effort EFFORT           推理强度（省略则使用模型默认档位；models 表中标为 - 的模型无此项，请勿传入）
  --mode MODE               显式覆盖审批模式：ask|auto|full|plan（省略则跟随本机/CLI 默认配置，与网页/App 新建一致；codex 与 claude 需启动后再切 plan）
  --standard-context        固定为 200k 标准上下文窗口（仅 Claude Code）
  --title TITLE             会话标题（最多 60 个字）
  --prompt TEXT             CLI 就绪后自动发送的首条消息（"-" 从标准输入读取）
  --login-shell             经用户登录 shell 启动，与网页/App 客户端新建会话一致
en:
Usage:
  remote-agent session create [flags] [-- cli-args]

Start a managed session without attaching and print its session ID.
Run "remote-agent models AGENT" first to inspect available model IDs, display names, supported efforts and this computer's effective defaults.

Flags:
  --agent {agents}          CLI to start (default: {defaultAgent})
  --cwd DIR                 working directory (default: current directory)
  --model MODEL             model ID or unambiguous display name (e.g. gemini-pro-orchestrator or "Orchestrator (Carbon)"; omit to follow machine/CLI default)
  --effort EFFORT           reasoning effort (omit to use default, or when "remote-agent models" shows "-")
  --mode MODE               explicit approval-mode override: ask|auto|full|plan (omit to follow machine/CLI defaults, matching Web/App new sessions; codex and claude switch to plan after launch)
  --standard-context        hold to the 200k standard context window (Claude Code)
  --title TITLE             session title (up to 60 characters)
  --prompt TEXT             first message sent once ready ("-" reads stdin)
  --login-shell             start through the user's login shell, like a client session
notes: remote-agent session create --help 的命令行用法说明；agents 为可选 CLI 竖线列表，defaultAgent 为默认 CLI 标识。

zh-CN:

en:

Pass an agent ID (e.g. "remote-agent models agy") to inspect one CLI, or omit it to list all enabled installed CLIs.
notes: remote-agent models --help 的命令行用法说明。

zh-CN: 模式必须是 ask、auto、full 或 plan（省略 --mode 则跟随本机/CLI 默认配置）

zh-CN:
用法：
  remote-agent session create [flags] [-- args]         后台新建托管会话（见 session create help）
  remote-agent session list [-a] [--json]               列出会话（-a 含已退出会话）
  remote-agent session get ID [--json]                  查看单个会话详情
  remote-agent session attach ID                        进入正在运行的会话终端
  remote-agent session send [--queue] ID TEXT           向会话发消息（"-" 读标准输入；--queue 等当前轮结束）
  remote-agent session cancel-input ID REQUEST-ID       撤回模型尚未收到的消息
  remote-agent session resume-input ID REQUEST-ID       继续发送因中断而暂停的消息
  remote-agent session events ID [-f] [--json]          查看或持续跟随（-f）会话事件流（支持 --after N）
  remote-agent session approve [--always] ID APPROVAL-ID
                                                        批准权限请求（--always：同类不再重复询问）
  remote-agent session deny [-m REASON] ID APPROVAL-ID  拒绝权限请求
  remote-agent session answer ID QUESTION-ID OPT[,OPT...]
                                                        回答模型的选择题
  remote-agent session plan ID implement|clear|keep     回答“是否实施此计划？”
  remote-agent session interrupt ID                     中断当前运行轮次
  remote-agent session model ID MODEL [EFFORT]          切换会话模型（支持运行中切模型的 CLI）
  remote-agent session mode ID ask|auto|full|plan       切换会话审批模式
  remote-agent session rename ID [TITLE]                重命名会话（省略标题恢复自动标题）
  remote-agent session compact ID                       压缩会话上下文
  remote-agent session stop ID                          结束会话
  remote-agent session resume ID                        重新启动已退出的会话并继续原对话
  remote-agent session fork ID                          从已有对话分叉出新会话

会话 ID 均可简写为任意唯一前缀。查看可选模型与默认配置请运行 remote-agent models [{agents}]。
en:
Usage:
  remote-agent session create [flags] [-- args]         start a session without attaching (session create help)
  remote-agent session list [-a] [--json]               list sessions (-a includes exited sessions)
  remote-agent session get ID [--json]                  inspect one session
  remote-agent session attach ID                        attach to a running session
  remote-agent session send [--queue] ID TEXT           send a message ("-" reads stdin; --queue waits for the turn to end)
  remote-agent session cancel-input ID REQUEST-ID       withdraw a message the model has not received
  remote-agent session resume-input ID REQUEST-ID       send a message paused by an interrupted turn
  remote-agent session events ID [-f] [--json]          show or follow (-f) session events (supports --after N)
  remote-agent session approve [--always] ID APPROVAL-ID
                                                        allow a permission request (--always: stop asking for similar ones)
  remote-agent session deny [-m REASON] ID APPROVAL-ID  deny a permission request
  remote-agent session answer ID QUESTION-ID OPT[,OPT...]
                                                        answer a model question
  remote-agent session plan ID implement|clear|keep     answer "Implement this plan?"
  remote-agent session interrupt ID                     interrupt the running turn
  remote-agent session model ID MODEL [EFFORT]          switch a session's model (for CLIs that support mid-session switching)
  remote-agent session mode ID ask|auto|full|plan       switch a session's approval mode
  remote-agent session rename ID [TITLE]                title the session (omit TITLE to restore automatic title)
  remote-agent session compact ID                       compact the session's context
  remote-agent session stop ID                          end the session
  remote-agent session resume ID                        restart an exited session on the same conversation
  remote-agent session fork ID                          fork a new session from an existing conversation

Session IDs may be abbreviated to any unique prefix. Run "remote-agent models [{agents}]" to inspect available models and defaults.
notes: remote-agent session help 的完整子命令参考。
